summary: queuemaster: unauthenticated access to the admin API (CVSS 9.1)
details: queuemaster 4.0 to 4.2.5, a message broker, serves its admin API without authentication when `admin.listen` is not set. Fixed in 4.2.6.

database_specific.note: Invented for the triage-evals test cases. Not a real advisory: it describes no real vulnerability.
